bio: Enjoy luxurious Afternoon Tea at the gorgeous Headlam Hall country hotel. Located in the picturesque rolling countryside of Durham's lower Teesdale, Headlam Hall is the perfect spot to experience some of the best Afternoon Tea and vistas Great Britain has to offer.  Afternoon Tea at Headlam Hall is served in the Main Hall Lounge, Library Bar, or Stable Lounge. With period features, antique furnishings, and open fires, Headlam Hall offers a distinctly luxurious Afternoon Tea experience, alongside some incredible views.  The menu features a delicious selection of dainty sandwiches, pastries, desserts, and teas.  The Headlam Hall Hotel is situated in lower Teesdale, a 20 minute drive from Darlington.
